citations.quoted_line: 他在報告裡寫，曾把十八片放給同一隻鴿子帶。
citations.original_reason: Major questions receive new facts: the leg note is attached and released (`script.md:99–119`), the lost equipment is replaced (`script.md:385–389`), one bird's reported load is eighteen films under one gram (`script.md:441–471`), the writing is enlarged in Paris (`script.md:515–523`), and the requested chemicals arrive (`script.md:569–589`).

citations.quoted_line: 那是他報告的一段鳥程，沒有量出每封私信多久抵達。
citations.original_reason: The final lines delimit what the twelve-hour flight and chemical delivery prove (`script.md:589–605`); they do not mention another video or file.

citations.quoted_line: 風向有利，大球也升起了；能越過軍線嗎？
citations.original_reason: After the opening balloon scene, the first chapter leaves at least three later outcomes open: crossing the line (`script.md:25`), attaching an airborne report (`script.md:33`), the bird's direction (`script.md:37`), and the bulk-mail load (`script.md:41`).

citations.quoted_line: 那些鳥的巢還在巴黎；先把牠們帶出城，才有朝家飛的方向。
citations.original_reason: Getting messages into besieged Paris by pigeon remains the concrete problem: one handwritten note establishes the route (`script.md:83–127`), Dagron gets film-making equipment out (`script.md:131–327`), and the film is made, attached, and re-sent (`script.md:335–553`).

citations.quoted_line: 村民還找了兩輛車，好搬走倖存的材料。
citations.original_reason: The extended escape keeps tracking whether Dagron can preserve the equipment needed to make mail films (`script.md:139–149`, `script.md:229–319`); the film, loading, repeat dispatch, and chemical request all show the mail route in use (`script.md:335–605`).
